title: Hold the Minister's approval to provide ambulance services
what: Provide ambulance services only with the Minister's approval.

sources.title: Emergencies Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 63(1) (current republication (R38, from 16 November 2025; Emergencies Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person is not approved by the Minister under this part to provide emergency, ambulance, firefighting or rescue services; and (b) the person provides emergency, ambulance, firefighting or rescue services
